title: Report Re Professor Zandor

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
Special Branch - H.Q. Station,
REPORT
Date December 14, 1934.

Subject (in full) Professor ZANDOR.

Made by D.S. Fitts. Forwarded by J.B.K.

In compliance with the instructions of the Deputy
Commissioner (Special Branch) relating to the attached newspaper
extract, I have to report that Professor Zandor is an American
named Fred Lewis ROCHON. He was born at Lodi, Michigan,
U.S.A. some 40 years ago, his home address being No. 14605
Higgins Street, Sherman Oaks, California. Rochon, who is in
possession of United States Passport No. 10 issued on January
6, 1931 at Olive, British Columbia, arrived in Shanghai on
July 21, 1934 as a passenger on board the S.S. "Golden Horn,"
having embarked on that vessel at San Francisco on June 11,
1934. He was accompanied by his wife Anna Edwina Rochon.
Mrs. Rochon has been residing at the Cathay Mansions
since her arrival here, whilst with the exception of a short
period in October when he was in Hankow and Nanking, Rochon has
also been staying at the same hotel.

Since his arrival in Shanghai Rochon has described
himself as (1) Hotel Manager, (2) Professor of Criminology and
(3) Advertising Expert. The latter term, however, appears to
fit this man's profession more correctly than the other two.

A few days after landing in Shanghai, Rochon, under the
name of Professor Zandor, approached the advertising department of
Messrs. Millington Ltd. and Messrs. Associated Advertisers and
placed before them a scheme for increasing the sale of certain
tinned edible commodities. These two concerns did their utmost
to find commissions for him but were unsuccessful in their
quest, with the result that during the early days of August, he
himself, still under the name of Professor Zandor, approached
Messrs. Bakerite Co., No. 107 Nanking Road and placed his pro-
position before the management of this concern. It so happened

特务科 - 总部警署，
报告
日期 1934年12月14日。

主题（全称）赞多尔教授（Professor ZANDOR）。

撰写人：D.S. Fitts。转呈人：J.B.K.

遵照副总监（特务科）关于所附报纸摘录的指示，本人谨此报告，赞多尔教授系一名美国人，名为弗雷德·刘易斯·罗雄（Fred Lewis ROCHON）。他约于40年前出生于美国密歇根州洛迪市（Lodi, Michigan），其家庭住址为加利福尼亚州谢尔曼奥克斯（Sherman Oaks）希金斯街14605号。罗雄持有1931年1月6日在不列颠哥伦比亚省奥利夫（Olive, British Columbia）签发的第10号美国护照，他作为乘客于1934年7月21日乘“金角号”轮船（S.S. "Golden Horn"）抵达上海，该船于1934年6月11日从旧金山启航。由其妻安娜·埃德温娜·罗雄（Anna Edwina Rochon）陪同。罗雄夫人自抵沪以来一直居住于华懋公寓（Cathay Mansions），而罗雄除10月份曾短暂前往汉口和南京外，也下榻于同一家酒店。

自抵达上海以来，罗雄自称身份为：(1) 酒店经理，(2) 犯罪学教授，以及 (3) 广告专家。然而，与其他两个头衔相比，“广告专家”这一称谓似乎更符合此人的职业。

在抵达上海数日后，罗雄以赞多尔教授的名义接触了美灵登有限公司（Messrs. Millington Ltd.）及联合广告公司（Messrs. Associated Advertisers）的广告部，并向他们提出了一项增加某些罐装食品销量的方案。这两家公司尽力为他寻找佣金机会，但均未成功，结果是在8月初，他本人仍以赞多尔教授的名义，接触了位于南京路107号的贝克莱特公司（Messrs. Bakerite Co.），并向该公司管理层提出了他的提议。碰巧的是

（印：副总监 1934年12月14日 （刑事科））

that this organisation intended embarking on an intensive
advertising campaign in August and September with the object
of selling to the local public various types of tinned biscuits.
By way of introduction to the public in question's name was the
inserting in each tin of biscuits of a slip of printed paper,
which when returned to his together with a piece of old worn
cloth and a specimen of the purchaser's handwriting, entitled
the latter to a free "character" reading and certain advice
regarding the future from "the one and only Professor Zandor."
To confirm his abilities as an expert advertising agent, Lochon
produced newspaper clippings which indicated that he had been
engaged in the same type of business in various parts of South
America, United States of America and Honolulu. In Honolulu
he was engaged by the Love Biscuit Company for a period of
two months during which time, due to his efforts, over 50,000
tins of biscuits of the organisation concerned were sold.

After some discussion Lochon's plans were eventually
adopted by the Bakerite Company and he was engaged to work
solely for that concern from August 15 until September 30, 1934.
He received a sum of over $4,000.00 plus his expenses in
connection with this contract and according to enquiries
made he put in a great deal of hard work to make a success of
the job he had in hand. He advertised extensively, both in
the local press and over Radio Station XJHA, extolling the values
of Bakerite Biscuits, and it is known that during the six
weeks that he was working for Bakerite, over 18,000 tins of
biscuits were sold in Shanghai in excess of the usual quota
for that period.

After his contract had expired he proceeded to Nanking

该机构正打算在8月和9月开展一场密集的广告宣传活动，旨在向当地公众销售各种类型的罐装饼干。作为向公众介绍的方式，即在每罐饼干中放入一张印刷纸条，当购买者将该纸条连同一片旧的磨损布料以及购买者的笔迹样本一并寄回给他时，便有权从“独一无二的赞多尔教授”处获得免费的“性格”解读以及关于未来的某些建议。为了证实其作为专业广告代理商的能力，罗雄出示了报纸剪报，显示他曾在南美洲、美国和夏威夷各地的同类业务中受聘。在夏威夷，他被乐福饼干公司（Love Biscuit Company）聘用两个月，在此期间，由于他的努力，该机构售出了超过50,000罐饼干。

经过一番讨论，罗雄的计划最终被贝克莱特公司采纳，他受聘 solely 为该公司工作，期限从1934年8月15日至9月30日。他就此合同获得了超过4,000.00美元的酬金及报销费用，据调查，他为做好手头的工作付出了大量辛勤努力。他在本地报刊和XJHA广播电台进行了大量广告宣传，极力推崇贝克莱特饼干的价值，据悉，在他为贝克莱特公司工作的六周期间，上海销售的饼干数量超过了该时期通常配额的18,000罐以上。

合同期满后，他前往南京
